surface: Full useGSAP hook contract: callback, dependency-array and config signatures; scoped contexts; contextSafe; revertOnUpdate; register; and headless.
divergences: The adapter imports Octane hooks and uses compiler-selected manual hook slots instead of React hooks.
GSAP remains an external peer dependency and is not redistributed by this MIT-licensed adapter.
ssr: Server rendering creates stable context helpers without running GSAP effects. Client hydration activates the standard lifecycle.
